mapper.select: SELECT s.org_id AS org_id, o.name AS org_name, s.include_children AS include_children FROM tab_admin_org_scope s INNER JOIN tab_org o ON o.id = s.org_id WHERE s.admin_id = #{adminId} ORDER BY o.show_order DESC, o.id ASC
SELECT s.* FROM tab_admin_org_scope s INNER JOIN tab_admin a ON a.id = s.admin_id AND a.status = 2000 WHERE a.user_id = #{userId}
